data.name: Settings_AboutText
data.value: AdbForge is a local desktop tool for Android / AOSP developers. All features communicate with the device via local adb: · No user data or device info is collected or uploaded · The only possible network access is the optional update check (only to the server URL you configure above) · Run logs are kept locally in %APPDATA%\AdbToolkit\logs and can be opened with one click above
